_why: NIGHT43 K1: `n43kiln steps --write` (Tools/SimHarness/Harness.N43.Kiln.cs): the apexes over a standing take-off on n43-kiln's floor, boost43 off and forced on (the ON side measured on port/stage3 with M1's boost43 code: K1's scratch copy; the real sim: jump held 1.0 s (no jump cut), the THUNDERCLAP tapped straight down at -0.15..+0.45 s from the jump press, the best of them; the double jump at the apex). Tools/night/gen-n43-kiln.cjs cuts THE STEPS from both (a lower bound takes the larger, an upper bound the smaller); climb = shot, the double jump at the apex, then the gun again as soon as it fires.
